# Scheduler Safety Checklist: Aegis Facility Singleton Refactor

- [ ] CHK005 Are no-row Aegis fallback requirements documented for scheduler review loops, including continued gateway fallback to agent id/name `aegis` without resolver crashes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK006 Are gateway-routing preservation requirements documented for both configured OpenClaw ids and session-key-derived routing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Are downstream SPEC-004 pipeline advancement and SPEC-005 `ready_for_owner` behaviors explicitly excluded from scheduler loop requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Constraints, Spec §Out of Scope, Spec §SC-009]
